signature: SUBROUTINE ZSPCON( UPLO, N, AP, IPIV, ANORM, RCOND, WORK, INFO )

params.name: uplo
N
params.reference: The order of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: AP
params.reference: The block diagonal matrix D and the multipliers used to obtain the factor U or L as computed by ZSPTRF, stored as a packed triangular matrix.

params.name: IPIV
params.reference: Details of the interchanges and the block structure of D as determined by ZSPTRF.

params.name: anorm
params.reference: The 1-norm of the original matrix A.

params.name: rcond
params.reference: The reciprocal of the condition number of the matrix A, computed as $\mathrm{RCOND} = 1/(\mathrm{ANORM} \, \mathrm{AINVNM})$, where AINVNM is an estimate of the 1-norm of inv(A) computed in this routine.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value
